# Full Security Audit

Run a complete end-to-end security audit on this project. Execute all 9 phases of the Steve pipeline:

1. **Business Discovery** — Understand what this project does, its industry, users, and compliance needs
2. **System Discovery** — Map tech stack, architecture, entry points, data flows
3. **Architecture Mapping** — Generate Mermaid diagrams, analyze at all levels, provide recommendations
4. **Threat Modeling** — STRIDE analysis per component, attack surface mapping
5. **Layered Security Audit** — 12-layer checklist audit with evidence collection
6. **License Compliance** — Scan dependencies for license conflicts and policy violations
7. **AI Opportunities** — Identify where AI/ML can improve security and features
8. **Risk & Remediation** — Score all findings, create prioritized fix plan
9. **Report Generation** — Executive summary + full technical report

Write all outputs to `audit-results/` directory.

Start with Phase 0: Read the README and key project files to understand the business context.
